notes.title: 🎉 HIBE Studio – Update Notes 🎉
notes.notes:
✨ What’s New?  
🎭 Live2D & VRoid Support
- Import your Live2D Avatars directly into HIBE Studio!  
- VRoid Hub Login – Easily access your VRoid Avatars with a click.  
- VRoid Avatars now support Avatar Effects & 3D Animations!  

🎥 Live Section Upgrades
- Better expressions, animations, and tracking for all avatar types!  

🚀 Other Enhancements
✅ New Live Layout – Cleaner & easier to use!  
✅ Audio Input for Lip Sync – More natural expressions!  
✅ Performance Boost – Faster & smoother experience!  
✅ Onboarding Fixes – Improved camera calibration!  

🔥 Coming Soon  
⏳ System-wide Hotkeys – Arriving next week for quick & easy control!  
🔗 Twitch & TikTok Login + Trigger System for Live Events.  
🎮 Multi-Player Streaming & Game Rooms – Stream together effortlessly!  

💬 Try it out & let us know what you think! 🚀✨
